_meta.notes: Item definitions per DESIGN.md Part 6.1. Every item declares use_kind: 'resources' means the server can use it and the numbers come from the category's effect keys below; 'unavailable' means it cannot be used yet, and use_reason says why the server refuses. Descriptions state the specific effect, so the panel never promises something the code does not do.

value.name: Starter Fertilizer
value.description: Worked into the soil under your crown, where it feeds the plant and enriches the dirt beneath it.

value.name: Starter Dung
value.description: Organic matter with water still in it. Feeds the plant and enriches the soil under its root.

value.name: Basic Gene Booster
value.description: A tuned gene compound, held for the booster system. Timed boosters are not implemented yet.
value.use_reason: Timed boosters are not implemented yet

value.name: Basic Heirloom Seed
value.description: A blank vessel for a future life. The heirloom planting flow is not implemented yet.
value.use_reason: Heirloom planting is not implemented yet

value.name: Offspring Seed
value.description: A seed carrying mixed genetics from your plant. Planting from the pouch is not implemented yet.
value.use_reason: Planting from the pouch is not implemented yet

value.name: Growth Essence
value.description: Bottled growth energy, drunk straight from the pouch.

item_definitions.notes: Starting item definitions. All account_bound items have tradeable/mailable/listable = false per RULE_23.

starting_inventory.notes: Items given to new players on first spawn.

inventory_slots.notes: Number of inventory slots per player.

fertilizer_minerals_gain.notes: Minerals added to the plant when a fertilizer item is used (clamped to capacity). This is the number a fertilizer's description quotes.

dung_water_gain.notes: Water added to the plant when a dung item is used (clamped to capacity).

dung_minerals_gain.notes: Minerals added to the plant when a dung item is used (clamped to capacity).

essence_energy_gain.notes: Energy restored when an essence item is used (clamped to capacity). This is the number an essence's description quotes.
